craft_notes: Sthāyin: maṅgala-bhakti of salute-and-likeness — imitation as veneration; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (door-command, terminal doctrine words; owner verdict required). Door-command: shelter-take, wander-never; grace-bent conquers; namaś sandhi per UNC. Rejected: (a) wander→roam → killed: wander is exile. (b) conquers→wins → killed: conquers commands. Read aloud: OM — BOW to-CON-scious-NESS-BHAI-ra-va … GRACE-bent ŚI-va CON-quers.

lines: Shelter-takers, take knowing's state, never wander vain — grace-bent Śiva conquers.
l4.sanskrit_cite: oṃ namaś cidbhairavāya | citibhūtiṃ śrayata mā mudhā bhramata

reads_against.argmap: Who is saluted, and who should shelter? → Salute Bhairava; shelter in ground; wander not; Śiva conquers.
c1_essence: Alone supreme nectar-one ablaze, all-swallowed: venerated.
Melted bliss-mass; principle likened in form venerated.
Script-outlines man; shape reveals varied You.
Light-goddess-flowers arranged; guru unfolded, heart entered.
Reflecting praise in body-temple, bonds outpoured.
Five-named conquer; splits gained, mouths called.
reads_against.c1_rasa: maṅgala-bhakti of salute; bhakti-vīra of praised alone; adbhuta of undiffering three; bhakti-adbhuta of likeness venerated; adbhuta of revealed shape; vīra of concept-free reflecting; bhakti of arranged offerings; bhakti-vīra of temple praise; vīra of conquering powers; adbhuta of corpse-seat
